description: This file contains serializer implementations for floating point and decimal types in the Orleans.Serialization library, including FloatCodec, DoubleCodec, DecimalCodec, and conditionally, HalfCodec for .NET 6+.

classes.name: FloatCodec
classes.description: Serialization logic for float values, supporting different wire types and platform-specific bit conversions.

classes.name: DoubleCodec
classes.description: Serialization logic for double values, supporting different wire types and platform-specific bit conversions.

classes.name: DecimalCodec
classes.description: Serialization logic for decimal values, including custom raw read/write methods.

classes.name: HalfCodec
classes.description: Serialization for Half-precision floating point (conditional on .NET 6+), includes conversion to/from raw 16-bit representation.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a float/double/decimal/half value to the buffer with appropriate headers and platform-specific conversions.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a float/double/decimal/half value from the buffer based on the wire type.

methods.name: ReadFloatRaw
methods.description: Reads raw float bits from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadDoubleRaw
methods.description: Reads raw double bits from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadDecimalRaw
methods.description: Reads raw decimal value from the buffer.

methods.name: ReadHalfRaw
methods.description: Conditionally compiled method to read raw Half value bits from the buffer.
